summary: Tested customer-reviews block on Sri Lanka, Vietnam and Egypt holidays pages. Initial run: ALL THREE pages crashed with runtime error 'd is not defined' (Emergent runtime error overlay). Root cause: ReviewCard subcomponent in EgyptCustomerReviews.jsx is defined at module scope but referenced d.readMore/d.readLess where d is only in scope inside the parent EgyptCustomerReviews component. Fixed by threading readMore/readLess through props. After the fix all three pages render correctly and content is country-specific: Sri Lanka heading 'Our customers about their Sri Lanka trip', summary mentions Sri Lanka, reviewers Iris/Viola/Astrid, no 'Egypt' text in block; Vietnam heading 'Our customers about their Vietnam trip', reviewers Camelia/Nicolas/Christina, no 'Egypt'; Egypt heading unchanged 'Our customers about their Egypt trip', reviewer Sibel present. 4.5 rating and '7,618 reviews' shown on all three; 4 photos rendered with 0 broken; 5 category ratings; Read more toggles between 'Read more' and 'Read less'; 'Show more reviews' clickable. Regression: Sri Lanka hero CTA still shows 'Browse 7 package ideas' and detail page (/asien/emerald-isle-explorer-sri-lanka) loads with correct H1. Mobile 390x844 on Sri Lanka: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), block renders correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError 'd is not defined' crashed Sri Lanka, Vietnam AND Egypt holidays pages via Emergent runtime error overlay. ReviewCard is at module scope but referenced parent's `d` closure. FIXED by passing readMore/readLess as props.

action_items: Fix has already been applied by testing agent (props threading in EgyptCustomerReviews.jsx). Please review the change and confirm it aligns with intended design; consider adding a lightweight test to catch module-scope closure bugs in future.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewCard was reading `d.readLess`/`d.readMore` from the enclosing scope even though it is defined at module level; this pattern is easy to overlook. Prefer defining subcomponents either inside the parent (to capture closure) or explicitly threading required props (current fix).

The old JSX still contained the exact readMore/readLess bug BEFORE this change per iteration history — recommend adding a smoke test rendering all 3 holidays pages headlessly to catch top-level crashes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EgyptCustomerReviews.jsx now takes optional `data` prop; ReviewCard receives readMore/readLess via props. All 3 holidays pages verified. If main agent tweaks the component further, retest all 3 pages for the same trio of assertions (heading country name, summary country name, reviewer names, no 'Egypt' leak in SL/VN).
rca of the issue: Reproduction: navigate to /asien/sri-lanka/holidays (also VN and Egypt) — Emergent runtime error 'd is not defined' displayed. Cause: EgyptCustomerReviews.jsx line 42 referenced `d.readLess`/`d.readMore` inside ReviewCard, which is declared at module scope (outside the parent component that owns `d = data`). At render time `d` is not in scope → ReferenceError. Mitigation applied: added readMore/readLess props to ReviewCard and passed them from the parent's map.
